SELECT P_Id AS pId, P_Name AS pName FROM ( SELECT pre_project.P_Id, pre_project.P_Name FROM pre_project LEFT JOIN inv_project_plan ON pre_project.P_ID = inv_project_plan.P_Id LEFT JOIN inv_fund_release ON inv_fund_release.Ifr_Id = inv_project_plan.Ifr_Id WHERE inv_project_plan.P_Id IS NOT NULL AND inv_fund_release.State = 7
and likePname(#{statisticsVo.projectName},pre_project.P_Id)=true
and pre_project.P_Name like concat('%',#{statisticsVo.projectName},'%')
) tq GROUP BY P_Id, P_Name

select pay.Pay_Create_Uid as createUid,pay.Pay_Create_Uname as createUname,pay.Pay_Create_Time as createTime, pay.Pay_State as state , pay.Pay_State_Time as stateTime, pay.con_id as conId , ( con.Con_Money_Total + COALESCE( (SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN cc.Con_Sup_Change_Mon_Type = 1 THEN cc.Con_Sup_Change_Money WHEN cc.Con_Sup_Change_Mon_Type = 0 THEN -Con_Sup_Change_Money ELSE 0 END ) FROM Con_Contract cc WHERE cc.Con_Sup = '是' AND cc.Con_Master_Con_Id IS NOT NULL AND cc.Con_Approval_State = 7 AND cc.Con_Master_Con_Id = con.con_id), 0 ) ) AS contractAmt, con.Con_Pay_Clause as csPaymentMethod, con.Con_Lower_Rate as csSettlemenDowngrading from Con_Contract con left join Con_Pay pay on con.con_id = pay.Con_Id where pay.Pay_State = 7 and con.Con_Approval_State = 7 AND TRUNC(pay.Pay_State_Time) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY

SELECT con.Con_Create_User_Id as createUid, con.Con_Create_User_Name as createUname, con.Con_Create_Time as createTime, con.Con_Approval_State as state, con.Con_Approval_Time as stateTime, con.con_id as conId, con.Con_Money_Total as csMoney , con.Con_Pay_Clause as csPaymentMethod FROM con_contract con LEFT JOIN Contract_Statistics cs ON con.con_id = cs.con_id WHERE cs.con_id IS NULL AND con.Con_Approval_State = 7
